# boomi_data_integration_environment (Resource)

A Data Integration environment. Environments are account-scoped and group connections and data flows.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "boomi_data_integration_environment" "example" {
  name        = "Production"
  description = "Production data flows"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Environment name.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Free-text description.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Environment ID, assigned by the API.
